source_lines.31: Let $k$ be any field, $n\geq 1$, and $\hbar\in k$. Let $\mathfrak h_n(k)$ and $W_n(k;\hbar)$ be as in [[def-heisenberg-lie-algebra]] and [[def-polynomial-weyl-algebra]]. Since $Z$ is central, define the quotient $Q_\hbar:=U(\mathfrak h_n(k))/(Z-\hbar1)$.

If $\hbar\ne0$, scaling $p_i\mapsto\hbar p_i$ gives $W_n(k;\hbar)\cong A_n(k)$; if $\hbar=0$, the defining generators commute.
